description: Create vendors table with RLS, soft-delete column, and category FK.
steps: Apply migration locally; assert vendors table exists with id/name/category_id/deleted_at columns.
Assert RLS enabled and 'vendors_select_active' policy exists.
Insert one test row; assert SELECT as anon returns it; UPDATE as anon rejected.

description: POST /vendors creates vendor row and triggers WhatsApp send.
steps: POST sample payload to /submit-vendor edge function; assert 200 + row inserted.
Assert whatsapp_send_log has one queued entry for this vendor.
Assert types.ts regenerated with Vendor row type.

description: Vendor add form at 375px — name, phone, category fields visible, ONE submit CTA.
steps: Visual assert: ONE primary submit CTA visible (no duplicate header button).
Visual assert: name/phone/category fields stack vertically.
Submit valid form; screenshot success state; assert success copy matches spec.
